info.name: Dr. Kim's Comments : Blueprint for New Robot

descriptions.notStarted: Dr. Kim of Omega Sector has apparently come up with something incredible...
descriptions.inProgress: Dr. Kim of Omega Sector gave me the Blueprint Machine for the new robot that's currently in development, and he requested that I show this to Chury, Hoony, and Gunny. I should meet up with #bChury#k first; he's at the #bOmega Sector Silo#k.
descriptions.completed: Dr. Kim gave me a mission to show Chury the blueprint of the new robot that he's currently making, and I did just that. Chury seemed impressed by it.
